language_task: Pick up the block and place it on the cardboard.
outcome_evidence: At frame 0, camera_high shows the green block to the left of the cardboard. Frames 280–350 in camera_wrist_right show the block retained between the fingers while the robot lifts and transfers it over the cardboard, consistent with the movement in camera_high. By frames 490–520, camera_high shows the green block on the cardboard as the gripper withdraws; camera_wrist_right shows the gripper empty. The block remains on the cardboard through frame 749 in camera_high. No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or harmful side effect is visibly established.
